items.title: Central AHU ventilation
items.text: Ventilation is provided through central air-handling equipment with outdoor-air intake and return/exhaust paths serving occupied areas.

items.title: Garage exhaust with demand control
items.text: Garage ventilation is controlled by carbon monoxide sensing with demand-based exhaust fan operation. This approach helps reduce fan runtime during low-occupancy periods.

items.title: Ventilation controls via BAS
items.text: Ventilation schedules and operating setpoints are integrated into BAS controls. Further trend review can help confirm outdoor-air control performance under varying occupancy.
